backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types (Skill, JobRole, Resume, UserProfile), persistent state maps, and initialization logic for default job roles including Data Analyst, Web Developer, AI Engineer, and DevOps Engineer with required skills.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting planned CSS/Tailwind configuration updates to implement a professional navy/charcoal/slate color palette and typography refinements across frontend components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/TSX files describing component functionality, styling approach, service integrations, and correct usage of types and API functions.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space with grayscale values for background, foreground, borders, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with viewport meta tag, page title 'AI-Based Skill Gap Analyzer for Students', root div, and module script reference to main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, analyze, dashboard, and admin pages, managing authentication state, profile setup modal display, and theme provider integration.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Access denied screen component displaying a shield alert icon, error message, and button to navigate back to home for unauthorized users.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: Higher-order component that checks admin permissions using useIsCallerAdmin hook and renders children only for authorized admins or shows AccessDeniedScreen.
frontend/src/components/DownloadReportBu: Button component that triggers PDF report generation using generateAnalysisReport service with job role, match results, missing skills, and recommendations data.
frontend/src/components/GapAnalysisResul: Component displaying matching and missing skills in two-column card layout with check/x icons, skill badges for level and category, and styled borders.
frontend/src/components/JobRoleForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing job roles with title input and dynamic skill management (add/remove skills with name, level, and category). Handles form submission with loading state and validation.
Component that fetches and displays available job roles as selectable cards, showing skill counts and badges. Includes loading skeleton, empty state, and confirmation button for selected role.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper with sticky header navigation, responsive mobile menu, authentication-aware links (Analysis, Admin Panel), and footer. Integrates LoginButton and admin role checking.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states. Clears query cache on logout and handles authentication errors.
frontend/src/components/ProficiencyGapCh: Bar chart visualization component using Recharts to display matching vs missing skills grouped by proficiency level (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup with fields for name (required), email, education, and experience. Non-dismissible until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/RecommendationsD: Displays personalized learning recommendations for missing skills, including course links with providers and practice project suggestions. Shows congratulatory message when no gaps exist.
frontend/src/components/ResumeUpload.tsx: React component for uploading PDF resumes with drag-and-drop support, file validation (PDF only, max 10MB), progress tracking, and PDF parsing before upload to backend.
frontend/src/components/SkillCategoryCha: Bar chart component using Recharts to visualize matching vs missing skills grouped by category (technical and soft skills).
Pie chart component using Recharts to display the proportion of matching skills versus missing skills.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor with authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, job roles, and resume operations, all using the actor hook for backend communication.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom professional navy and charcoal color palette defined using OKLCH color space for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page for managing job roles with CRUD operations (add, edit, delete). Uses AdminGuard for access control and displays job roles in a card grid with skill badges.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard displaying skill gap analysis results including match percentage, charts (skill match, category, proficiency gap), gap analysis results, recommendations, and download report functionality.
frontend/src/pages/AnalysisFlow.tsx: Two-step wizard flow for skill analysis: first uploads resume, then selects target job role before navigating to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero section and feature cards explaining the skill gap analysis process (upload resume, select job role, view analysis, get recommendations).
frontend/src/services/gapAnalysis.ts: Service that identifies missing skills by comparing normalized extracted resume skills against job role requirements using string matching.
frontend/src/services/nlpService.ts: Simulated PDF parsing service that returns sample resume text; intended to be replaced with actual PDF parsing library in production.
frontend/src/services/pdfGenerator.ts: Generates downloadable text-based skill gap analysis reports as plain text files; placeholder for future PDF generation using libraries like jsPDF.
frontend/src/services/recommendationEngi: Generates personalized course and project recommendations for missing skills using hardcoded databases of courses (Udemy, Coursera) and project ideas with fuzzy matching.
frontend/src/services/skillExtraction.ts: Extracts technical and soft skills from resume text by matching against predefined skill lists (JavaScript, Python, React, AWS, communication, leadership, etc.) and returns normalized skill names.
frontend/src/services/skillMatching.ts: Calculates skill match percentage between extracted resume skills and job role requirements using exact and partial string matching, returning matching skills and percentage score.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color scheme (HSL-based theme variables), typography settings with Inter font, extended spacing/sizing, and animation keyframes for UI components.
project_state.json: Project metadata documenting the AI-Based Skill Gap Analyzer architecture (React/TypeScript frontend, Motoko backend, Internet Identity auth, NLP integration) with implemented features and architectural notes.
